text: Advancing M.Sc. thesis research on Dual-Teacher Adaptive Agreement (DTAA) for Federated Semi-Supervised Learning (FSSL) in Abdominal Trauma CT Segmentation at University of Lagos.
Completed and presented M.Sc. seminar research on 'Federated Learning in Healthcare: Privacy-Preserving Collaborative Machine Learning Across Clinical Silos'.
Released create-quadstack on NPM — open-source CLI tool for scaffolding cloud-native backend environments.
Engineered real-time data ingestion pipelines for QuantCore.ai, transitioning to WebSockets and Redis caching with sub-50ms latency.
Surpassed 500+ mentored software engineers and learners across Nigeria in distributed systems, API architecture, and database design.
Co-authored research on ensemble models in chronic kidney disease classification published in IJAMEC.
